scripts.test: npm run test:pytest && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:source && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:source: bash scripts/run_playwright.sh --asset-bundle-mode source tests/js/e2e/boot-resilience.spec.js tests/js/e2e/share.spec.js tests/js/e2e/source-lazy-smoke.spec.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:docker && npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:json && npm run lint:md && npm run vendor:check && npm run assets:check && npm run assets:inventory:check
scripts.lint:py: ruff check --config .tooling/ruff.toml app/ tests/py/ scripts/backup_system.py scripts/build_release_evidence.py scripts/build_release_payload.py scripts/check_pytest_partitions.py scripts/check_source_licenses.py scripts/restore_system.py scripts/summarize_pytest_junit.py && bandit -r app/ -ll -q && python scripts/check_source_licenses.py
scripts.audit: npm run audit:py && npm run audit:js
scripts.assets:check: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && node scripts/build_assets.mjs --out-dir "$tmp" --check && root_cwd=$(mktemp -d) && scripts_cwd=$(mktemp -d) && node scripts/build_assets.mjs --out-dir "$root_cwd" --no-precompress && (cd scripts && node build_assets.mjs --out-dir "$scripts_cwd" --no-precompress) && diff -qr "$root_cwd" "$scripts_cwd"
